pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pSupplies carbon to a correctly aligned Flawless Greenhouse by burning fuel and consuming FE per fuel item.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place it three blocks to the specified side of the Flawless controller, same facing.$p2. Provide a valid fuel and enough FE for the entire fuel start.$p3. Use Controlled Fuel for the configured high-carbon pause/resume behavior.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pAt the shipped values Controlled Fuel pauses at 100% and resumes at 92%, preserving paused burn time. Wrong position/facing prevents the intended link.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
